acceptance_criteria_source: design_docs/implemented/r2/camera-forward.md ## Acceptance criteria (AC1-AC14, each with its exact command and log line; AC14 checked at landing)

acceptance_commands.AC-B1: test $(git ls-files '*.gd' | xargs grep -nE '\[2\], *-[a-z_.]*\[1\]|\.x, *-[a-z_.]*\.z, *[a-z_.]*\.y|-[a-z_.]*\.x, *[a-z_.]*\.y, *-[a-z_.]*\.z' | grep -vE '^(interior/ship_frame|demos/ship_demo_camera)\.gd:' | wc -l) -eq 0 && test $(grep -cE '\[2\], *-[a-z_.]*\[1\]|\.x, *-[a-z_.]*\.z, *[a-z_.]*\.y|-[a-z_.]*\.x, *[a-z_.]*\.y, *-[a-z_.]*\.z' tests/fixtures/basis_gate/inline.gd.txt) -ge 3
acceptance_commands.AC-B2: grep -qE '^ok    basis R proper bow->\+Z mast->\+Y$' $S/camera-forward-test.log
acceptance_commands.AC-B3: make physics $A > $S/physics.txt && grep -q "^$(cat tests/fixtures/physics_total.txt) passed, 0 failed" $S/physics.txt
acceptance_commands.AC-B4: make golden $A && tools/golden_baseline.sh check $S/golden.log tests/fixtures/golden_baseline_ok.txt && tools/golden_baseline.sh selftest
acceptance_commands.AC-B5: test -z "$(git diff --name-only origin/main -- sim/)" && make parity replay strict $A
acceptance_commands.AC-B6: make lore-import CHECK=1 D=../stapledons-design AILANG=ailang && make lore-check lore-test $A
acceptance_commands.AC-V1: test $(grep -cE '^ok    yaw constant (bow|astern) spread=0\.[0-9]+ deg over 16$' $S/camera-forward-test.log) -eq 2
acceptance_commands.AC-V4: grep -qE '^ok    captain px bow (6[0-9]|7[0-9]|80)\.\.(6[0-9]|7[0-9]|80)$' $S/camera-forward-test.log && grep -qE '^ok    deck fraction bow 0\.[5-7][0-9]$' $S/camera-forward-test.log
acceptance_commands.AC-V5: test $(grep -cE '^ok    (W up-screen|D right) (bow|astern)$' $S/camera-forward-test.log) -eq 4 && test $(grep -cE '^ok    W up-screen after switch (bow>astern|astern>bow)$' $S/camera-forward-test.log) -eq 2
acceptance_commands.AC-V7: grep -qE '^ok    envelope keeps the angle$' $S/camera-forward-test.log && grep -qE '^ok    eye above deck at 32 samples$' $S/camera-forward-test.log
acceptance_commands.AC-V8: test $(grep -cE '^ok    (switch ease max [0-9.]+ deg/s|reduced cut|mapping at ease end|console returns to (bow|astern) exact)$' $S/camera-forward-test.log) -eq 5
acceptance_commands.AC-V9: grep -qE '^ok schema v2$' $S/camera-test.log && test $(grep -cE '^ok negative control v2 ' $S/camera-test.log) -eq 7
acceptance_commands.AC-V12: grep -qE '^ok    fade leaves sky and sim untouched$' $S/camera-forward-test.log
